questions.q: The structured process of equipping young people with the requisite knowledge, skills, and resources needed to become self-reliant and productive members of society is known as...
questions.explain: **Youth empowerment** is a mechanism of structural and capacity building that prepares the younger generation to overcome life challenges, achieve financial independence, and contribute positively to national development.

questions.q: A youth who undergoes an intensive apprenticeship in fashion designing, carpentry, or auto-mechanics to start a private business is primarily acquiring...
questions.explain:
Empowerment skills are grouped into various categories:

| Skill Category | Examples |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Vocational / Technical** | Tailoring, Carpentry, Plumbing, Auto-mechanics |
| **Life Skills** | Communication, Problem-solving, Decision making |
| **Entrepreneurial** | Business management, Financial literacy, Marketing |

Learning a specific trade like fashion designing falls strictly under **vocational and technical skills**.

questions.q: In the context of youth development, skills such as effective communication, critical thinking, and conflict resolution are fundamentally classified as...
questions.explain: **Life skills** are psychosocial competencies and interpersonal abilities that help youth make informed decisions, communicate effectively, develop coping mechanisms, and manage a healthy lifestyle.

questions.q: Which of the following represents a major socio-economic benefit of providing adequate empowerment skills to the youth of a nation?
options: It guarantees automatic electoral victory for the ruling political party.
It eliminates the necessity of establishing public tertiary educational institutions.
It significantly reduces the rate of youth unemployment, poverty, and crime.
It ensures that the nation relies exclusively on imported manufactured goods.
questions.explain: When youths are economically and intellectually empowered, they become job creators rather than job seekers. This self-reliance **drastically reduces poverty, idleness, and involvement in social vices and criminal activities**.

questions.q: The statutory federal agency established by the Nigerian government specifically to combat mass unemployment through the provision of vocational training and youth capacity-building programs is the...
questions.explain: The **National Directorate of Employment (NDE)** was established in 1986 to design and implement programs to combat mass unemployment, particularly among school leavers and graduates, through skills acquisition, vocational training, and entrepreneurial empowerment.
